g.text: Node, pose, vertex: one place, several names

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: A node is a place in the layout. A pose is that place plus a heading. A vertex is the number gg_ gives one pose. W22 is one node, four poses and four vertices; the arrows are the only conversions the code performs
